test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The one who loves mankind
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Philanthropist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 4, philanthropist.**
 
• A **philanthropist **is a person **who loves mankind and is actively involved in promoting human welfare and improving the quality of life for others.**
 
 
• For example, Bill Gates is a well-known **philanthropist **who has donated billions of dollars to various charitable causes.
 
 
 
• **Option 1, pessimist,** refers to a person who always sees the negative side of things and expects the worst outcome.
 
 
• For example, a pessimist might say "I don't think we'll ever solve this problem."
 
 
 
• **Option 2, misogynist,** refers to a person who hates or has a strong dislike for women.
 
 
• For example, a misogynist might make derogatory comments about women or discriminate against them in the workplace.
 
 
 
• **Option 3, optimist,** refers to a person who always sees the positive side of things and expects the best outcome.
 
 
• For example, an optimist might say "I'm sure we'll find a solution to this problem."
